title: Mobile video playback and project context
items: Video previews load before a fresh tap starts playback on iPhone. Playback failures now show a retry action.
Starting another video pauses the previous video, including when using native playback controls.
AI ZIP and RAG exports use neutral filenames. Project names are excluded from retrieved context, with instructions to ignore names retained in editable backups or older metadata.
Update FUPCJ Server for name-free live RAG context, then refresh Vision. Existing lightweight 480-pixel H.264 previews are reused.
